description: Starter supply-chain exposure catalog for the omarchy bumblebee plugin. Well-known public incidents only — add your own advisories as *.json files (same shape) under ~/.config/omarchy/plugins-data/bumblebee/catalog.d/ and they merge at scan time.

entries.name: chalk npm account-takeover release (Sep 2025 qix phish)
entries.notes: GHSA-2v46-p5h4-248w / MAL-2025-46969 — maintainer phished 2025-09-08; chalk@5.6.1 shipped a crypto-clipping payload.

entries.name: debug npm account-takeover release (Sep 2025 qix phish)
entries.notes: GHSA-4x49-vf9v-38px — debug@4.4.2 published 2025-09-08 with a browser crypto-stealer payload.

entries.name: event-stream flatmap-stream injection (2018)
entries.notes: Malicious flatmap-stream dependency injected into event-stream@3.3.6 to harvest Copay bitcoin wallet keys.

entries.name: ua-parser-js hijacked releases (Oct 2021)
entries.notes: GHSA-pjwm-rvh2-c87w / CVE-2021-4229 — hijacked releases bundled a cryptominer and credential stealer.

entries.name: rc npm account-takeover releases (Dec 2021)
entries.notes: Same hijack campaign as coa/ua-parser-js — trojanized rc releases dropped credential stealers.

entries.name: node-ipc protestware wiper (Mar 2022)
entries.notes: CVE-2022-23812 — overwrote files on hosts geolocated to RU/BY; 9.2.2 and >=11.0.0 also bundle peacenotwar.

entries.name: ctx PyPI domain-expiry takeover (May 2022)
entries.notes: GHSA-4g82-3jcr-q52w / PYSEC-2022-199 — every release uploaded after the 2014 original exfiltrated os.environ (AWS keys).

entries.name: xz-utils upstream backdoor (CVE-2024-3094)
entries.notes: Backdoored xz 5.6.x tarballs targeted sshd via liblzma; may also surface as xz-utils/liblzma in lockfiles.
